name: 97814 · Baker City, OR
findings: ZIP 97814 (Baker City) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97814 (Baker City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97814 (Baker City) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
